typedef bool(*) parallel_connect_should_exit_fn(void *user_data)

Callback type to check if connection should be abandoned. Called periodically by connection threads to allow graceful shutdown. Should return true if connection attempts should stop immediately.

Parameters

user_data Opaque pointer provided by caller

Returns

true to abandon connection attempts, false to continue
